# Project Template {#sec-project-template}

```markdown
# Project: [title]

**Difficulty:**
**Time:**
**Learning focus:**
**Module:**

## Overview

## Learning objective

## Inputs and outputs

## Build steps

## Core check

## Failure to test

## Extension

## Evidence

## Risk and mitigation

## Demo plan
```

## Review checklist

- [ ] The project runs from the README
- [ ] The objective is visible
- [ ] The model call is in one place
- [ ] The secret is outside the code
- [ ] One success and one failure are tested
- [ ] The limitation is documented
- [ ] The demo explains the idea
- [ ] The student can explain the model call

## Assessment rubric

| Level | Understanding | Evidence | Explanation | Responsible use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | Explains the wrapper and the model call | Tests success and failure | Clear and accurate | Discloses and protects data |
| 3 | Explains most of the call | Tests success | Mostly clear | Mostly responsible |
| 2 | Explains the output only | Limited evidence | Vague | Partial disclosure |
| 1 | Cannot explain the call | No test | Copies the demo | Ignores policy |
